dialect.description: The shell dialect to parse and format the files as.

oneOf.description: Uses the dialect of the shebang, then of the file extension, falling back to Bash.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent.

useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs instead of spaces.

binaryNextLine.description: Whether binary operators (`&&`, `||` and `|`) go at the start of the next line instead of at the end of the line.

switchCaseIndent.description: Whether to indent the pattern arms of a `case` statement.

spaceRedirects.description: Whether to put a space between a redirect operator and its target (ex. `> file` instead of `>file`).

keepPadding.description: Whether to keep the spaces that align columns between tokens.

functionNextLine.description: Whether to put the opening brace of a function on the next line.

neverSplit.description: Whether to keep statements on a single line where possible.

simplify.description: Whether to rewrite redundant syntax to simpler forms (ex. `${foo}` to `$foo`).

minify.description: Whether to remove comments and extra whitespace to make the code small.
